name: TYC 5164-567-1
description: A star 0.89 solar radii and 0.9 solar masses that turns once in 4.68 days; its magnetic field has been mapped.

radius.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: radius 0.89 solar radii

mass.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: mass 0.9 solar masses

temperature.source: TESS Input Catalog 8.2 (VizieR IV/39/tic82), TIC 243635796: Teff

spin.source: Folsom et al., arXiv:1601.00684, Table 2: rotation period 4.68 d and an axis 65 degrees from the line of sight, the values its magnetic maps were made with

color.reason: The Washington Double Star catalogue (Mason et al. 2001, AJ 122, 3466; VizieR B/wds/wds) lists WDS 20048-0239 ELP 45 AB: 2.7 arcsec apart, magnitudes 8.05 and 10.31: the companion gives 11.1% of the light, which a measured spectrum would blend with the star's. The color is the Planck spectrum at the star's temperature

text.card: A star 89% of the Sun's width that turns once in 4.68 days, with a mapped magnetic field.
text.introduction: Folsom et al. give it 0.89 solar radii, 0.9 solar masses, a rotation period of 4.68 days and an axis tilted 65° from the line of sight.
